tuples.subject: penal_interest
tuples.quote: shall not be levied in the form of ‘penal interest’ that is added to the rate of interest charged on the advances.

tuples.subject: penal_charges
tuples.quote: Penalty, if charged, for non-compliance of material terms and conditions of loan contract by the borrower shall be treated as ‘penal charges’

tuples.subject: penal_capitalisation
tuples.quote: There shall be no capitalisation of penal charges i.e., no further interest computed on such charges.

tuples.subject: other
tuples.special_circumstance: REs shall not introduce any additional component to the rate of interest
tuples.quote: The REs shall not introduce any additional component to the rate of interest
